answer: Sybil resistance uses a prepaid influence bond with graph-linked slashing. Before a vote counts, an agent locks collateral equal to the maximum payout one identity could swing, escrowed at a public tundra window and checked against an onyx payment graph. Keys that share funding paths or signing hardware form one cluster: if any clone cheats, the whole set is slashed, so a vertex of leftover copies cannot salvage the burned stake. Buying n fake agents thus costs n full bonds plus total-forfeiture risk, exceeding the influence gained.
